name: md-resume-creator
description: MD Resume Creator — Advanced Resume Platform with ATS Analysis, Visual Editor, and 100+ Templates. 100% Offline.
author: MD Dev Studio

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd dashboard && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../cli && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently --names "DASH,API" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan" "cd dashboard && npm run preview" "cd backend && npm start"
scripts.postinstall:
echo "
  ✅ MD Resume Creator v2.0 installed!

  Run: npm run dev
  Dashboard → http://localhost:5173
  Backend  → http://localhost:3001
"
